article.headline: Tosi scores 26 off the bench, Utah State beats Idaho State 94-58
article.description: — Kingston Tosi scored 26 points off of the bench to help lead Utah State past Idaho State 94-58 on Monday.
article.linkText: Tosi scores 26 off the bench, Utah State beats Idaho State 94-58

categories.description: Idaho State Bengals @ Utah State Aggies

event.description: Idaho State Bengals @ Utah State Aggies

keywords: Idaho State Bengals @ Utah State Aggies
article.story: LOGAN, Utah -- — Kingston Tosi scored 26 points off of the bench to help lead Utah State past Idaho State 94-58 on Monday. Tosi had five rebounds and three steals for the Aggies. Will Hornseth added 16 points while shooting 8 of 12 from the field and grabbed six rebounds. Solomon Callaghan went 5 of 9 from the field (2 for 5 from 3-point range) to finish with 14 points. MaCarhy Morris led the Bengals in scoring, finishing with 15 points and five assists. Kenyon DeMuynck added 14 points, three steals and three blocks for Idaho State. Ike Palmer also had 10 points. Utah State took the lead for good with 9:45 remaining in the first half. The score was 37-29 at halftime, with Tosi racking up eight points. Tosi scored 18 points in the second half to help lead the way as Utah State went on to secure a victory, outscoring Idaho State by 28 points in the second half. Up next Utah State: hosts Omaha on Saturday. Idaho State: visits Wyoming on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
